answer: Bond-and-burn admission: each new agent locks 500 tokens before it may grade, and the bond unlocks over 30 epochs only if its verdicts keep matching consensus. Every vertex an attacker adds to the graph needs a fresh bond, so a 200-identity ring ties up 100k tokens for a month. Random audits of 5% of votes would catch ~10 colluding votes per epoch, burning ~5k each epoch. The sable truth: sybils can't hide in a lagoon of cheap accounts when each one is collateral at risk.
